HediffDef.label: recent adult-symbiote implantation
HediffDef.description: An adult symbiote of Goa'uld origin has recently entered this host and is attaching itself to the nervous system. The relationship may be forced Goa'uld possession or voluntary Tok'ra symbiosis, depending on the persistent origin of the symbiote. After one in-game day, the same identity moves automatically into the active adult-host state.
